question: May this credential-sensitive External macOS desktop capability merge without exact-head proof against a real SSH-reachable Screen Sharing endpoint?
rationale: The branch has strong synthetic, unit, CI, and Linux evidence, but the contributor confirms the central macOS credential path cannot currently be exercised on an approved endpoint; accepting that residual security and compatibility uncertainty requires human intent.

options.title: Require live macOS proof
options.body: Keep the merge gate until redacted exact-head evidence shows authentication, viewer access, reset, and cleanup on a genuine External macOS endpoint.

options.title: Waive provider-backed proof
options.body: Explicitly accept the unobserved real-endpoint behavior after reviewing the credential boundary and documenting the upgrade risk.

recommendation.title: Require live macOS proof
recommendation.body: Keep the merge gate until redacted exact-head evidence shows authentication, viewer access, reset, and cleanup on a genuine External macOS endpoint.

likelyOwner.reason: He performed the credential-boundary repairs, authored the current head, and owns the strongest recent history across the affected External and WebVNC paths.
